meta.title: KORTEX | Technology • Creativity • Experiences
meta.description: KORTEX is an Ivorian brand that uses technology to create products, services and experiences across several universes: design, artificial intelligence, training, and beyond.

footer.tagline: More than a company, an ecosystem. An Ivorian brand driven by technology.

hero.title: Ideas for today. Possibilities for tomorrow.
hero.subtitle: KORTEX is an Ivorian brand that uses technology to create products, services and experiences across several universes.

manifesto.title: More than a company, an ecosystem.
manifesto.text: KORTEX doesn’t just sell technology. Technology is our engine: it lets us create, under one identity, across very different universes.

universes.title: One ecosystem. Many movements.
universes.text: Three universes carry KORTEX’s activity today. Others are taking shape, at their own pace, on the same technology foundation.

vision.title: One brand. Many movements.
vision.text: KORTEX starts with technology, but our ambition goes beyond technology. We want to build a brand able to create products, services, experiences and communities across several universes.
vision.ambition: Building an African technology brand able to grow across several universes.
vision.diagramLabel: Diagram: KORTEX at the centre; DESIGN, AI and TRAINING on an inner orbit; the universes in development on an outer orbit.

services.title: Clear offers to get started.
services.text: KORTEX’s operational universes, and what they can do for you today.

approach.title: Five steps. One standard.
approach.text: Whatever the universe, every project follows the same path, from the first conversation onwards.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: Listen, and analyse the context, the users and the goals before any decision.

design.title: Design
design.text: Imagine the solution, the identity and the experience. Prototype, test, adjust.

build.title: Build
build.text: Produce with rigour: careful work, verified deliverables, consistent quality.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.text: Launch, deliver, train and support the handover.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.text: Measure, improve and grow the project over time.

about.title: KORTEX DIGITAL is the company behind KORTEX.
about.text: An Ivorian company, founded in Abidjan, to build digital solutions and, over time, an ecosystem of brands and experiences under one identity.

meta.title: Our universes
meta.description: KORTEX DESIGN, KORTEX AI, KORTEX TRAINING and the expanding universes of the KORTEX ecosystem.

universes.title: One ecosystem. Many movements.
universes.text: Technology is the foundation; the universes are the brand’s movements. Each has its own audience and offer, all share the KORTEX identity.
universes.expansionText: These universes are being built step by step, according to demand and our capacity. They are not open yet.
universes.disclaimer: KORTEX universes are brand lines carried by KORTEX DIGITAL, not separate companies.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.text: Structure KORTEX DIGITAL, consolidate DESIGN, AI and TRAINING, serve the first clients.

tech.title: Technology expansion
tech.text: Develop DEV, SECURITY, CLOUD and DATA according to demand.

products.title: Product creation
products.text: Turn recurring needs into digital products and SaaS.

universes.title: New universes
universes.text: Gradually roll out MEDIA, PLAY, LOISIR, SPORT, CULTURE, EXPERIENCE and TRAVEL.

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
ecosystem.text: Make the universes work together: a multi-universe brand driven by technology.

meta.title: Our services
meta.description: Logos, visual identity, motion design, websites, apps, AI solutions, consulting and training: KORTEX offers, quoted on request.

services.title: Clear offers, every project tailored.
services.text: The services of KORTEX’s three operational universes. Each project is quoted on request, according to its scope.
services.quoteNote: All our services are quoted on request. Each project is scoped, then priced according to your goals, its complexity, deliverables and timeline.

contactBand.title: Let’s build something.
contactBand.text: A project, an idea, a question? Let’s talk. We get back to you quickly.

meta.title: About
meta.description: KORTEX DIGITAL, a single-member limited company based in Abidjan, is the company behind the KORTEX brand.

about.title: The company behind the brand.
about.intro: KORTEX DIGITAL is an Ivorian technology company. It carries the KORTEX brand and develops its universes: design, artificial intelligence, training, and many more to come.
about.visionStatement: Building an African technology brand able to grow across several universes.
about.visionText: KORTEX starts from technology know-how and aims to turn it, step by step, into a platform for creating products, services and experiences. Each universe has its own market and offer, while drawing on the ecosystem’s technology and creative capabilities.
about.companyText: KORTEX is the brand; KORTEX DIGITAL is the company behind it, based in Abidjan, with ambitions beyond the Ivorian market.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Solutions that are easy to understand, use and evolve.

rigor.title: Rigour
rigor.text: Careful work, justified choices, commitments kept.

transmission.title: Transmission
transmission.text: We share what we know to make people autonomous.

impact.title: Impact
impact.text: Every project must solve a real problem.

about.originText: The cortex is the part of the brain that processes information and makes decisions. That is our role: turning ideas into products, services and experiences that work.

meta.title: Insights
meta.description: Articles and analysis from KORTEX on technology, AI, design and creation.

insights.title: Notes on technology, creation and the KORTEX universes.
insights.emptyText: We will publish our analysis and lessons learned here. Check back soon.

meta.title: Careers
meta.description: Join KORTEX DIGITAL in Abidjan: design, artificial intelligence, development and training.

careers.title: Let’s build together.
careers.text: KORTEX is just starting. We are looking for demanding, curious people who want to build a brand and its universes.
careers.noOpenings: No open positions at the moment.
careers.spontaneousText: Send us your profile and a few words about what you would like to build.
